notes.notes:
[b]Oh boy, this one is dangerous![/b] We’ve got a new update that brings some new fight mechanics into the game. It's pretty experimental, and we are deeply sorry about the bugs. [h3]New stuff[/h3]

[list]
[*] Can now craft from nearby village stockpiles or other inventories (except NPCs)

[*] Most received attacks now trigger a flinch animation instead of full knockback
[*] Only specific attacks now cause the player to tumble--bear swipe, bison charge, mammoth slam
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.7.13
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, friends![/b] We’ve got a major update for you—one that brings big changes and big potential… to break things. 😅 Please bear with us as we roll this out, and help us make Polylithic better by reporting any bugs or issues on our [url=https://www.discord.gg/polyperfect]Discord[/url] 

[h3]New Happiness System & Tribe Overview (Beta)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/9ccceeb784edf9973a6f2cc69f6e0cef8115c2ab.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Global Happiness System added – affects the entire tribe.
[*] Food variety and surplus provide happiness boosts, rationing and scarcity cause drops.
[*] Each tribe member needs a place to stay and a bed to sleep on
[*] Housing Types: Stalk Cover, Hut, and House with different capacities and decoration support.
[*] Decorations now boost happiness (varies by housing).
[*] The decoration bonus applies only if people live in the house.
[*] Luxury Foods (bread, milk, meat) give happiness boosts.
[*] Tribe size now impacts happiness via a member penalty.
[*] Envy system added – members may get unhappy if housed unequally.
[*] Without proper food, housing, and decoration, happiness drops.
[*] At low happiness, tribe members may leave.
[*] Max sustainable tribe size (without issues): ~13 with full luxury setup.
[*] Overloading on poor housing types leads to limited happiness.
[*] New window for the tribe overview.
[*] New window for resources overview.
[/list]

The next step will be to add the positive and negative effects and balance the system more.

[h3]First Multiplayer Test![/h3]

[previewyoutube=FJ5lqFTwoBA;full][/previewyoutube]

We did our first multiplayer test today! 🎉 It's still a work in progress, but it’s already a blast (though sadly, my mic wasn’t recorded). If you want to help shape the future of Polylithic multiplayer and jump into beta testing with us, please let us know!

[h3]Performance Update[/h3]

[list]
[*] Loading the World chunks in the Sandbox mode
[*] Save and Load performance
[/list]

We will polish the new features in the upcoming small updates and continue to work on the new Fight and camera system, the New Campaign, and multiplayer, along with sandbox improvements, to get ready for the 1.0 release.

Dear Tribe Members!
Happy to see you in the new year. This will be a year of Polylithic! (Or at least, that's the plan...)

[list]
[*] [b]Reworked the Prologue:[/b] Yes, we reworked it—again! We’re committed to making it just right.
[*] [b]Mob Spawner Improvements:[/b] Cooldowns now consider death time instead of spawn time and are tracked per entity instead of per group for better balance.
[/list]
[h3]We are currently working on[/h3]

[h3]Happy Holidays from the Polylithic Team! 🎄[/h3]

Greetings, Tribe Members!

As we approach the end of the year, we want to take a moment to reflect, share some exciting updates, and express our heartfelt gratitude for your incredible support. We delivered nearly 50 updates this year, and we couldn’t have done it without your enthusiasm and feedback.

We’re thrilled to share what’s in store for next year! Expect an exciting new fighting system, multiplayer features, and even more creative ideas to enhance your gameplay experience.

[b]Thank you for being an essential part of our journey. Here’s to an even more epic year ahead![/b]

[*] Improved VRAM usage by ~100MB

notes.title: Version 0.7 / 1 Year of Early Access
notes.notes:
[h3]Fellow Tribemembers[/h3]

[h3]The 0.7 is here, and with it, we prepared a video recapping the last six months of polylithic development. It has also already been a year in Early Access; wow! Time flies fast, and I am sorry that the game is still not finished, but those of you who are following us closely know that we are constantly pushing and improving the world of polylithic, and there are great things stored for you in the future.[/h3]

[h3]Release notes for 0.7[/h3]

[list]
[*] Hostile mobs no longer spawn around the player but spawn based on Biome instead
[*] Hostile mobs no longer spawn from certain spawners on the first day in Sandbox
[*] Fixed an issue where tribe members would sometimes not be available for inspection in the pause menu or Tasks after Migrations
[*] Fixed an issue where tribe members would not migrate to the new site if both Migrations are done in a single session
[*] Reduced intermittent stutters during gameplay
[*] Improved physics efficiency
[*] Fixed errors caused when loading old terrain in Sandbox
[*] The surface of water no longer casts shadows
[*] Fixed Pongo aggressively sniffing the player
[*] New title screen video
[/list]

[previewyoutube=V_aOL2B6rJU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]We made many changes to the code and switched the engine version. This should bring a significant performance boost, but there might be problems, so please let us know if you find something![/b]

Also, feel free to join us in the playthrough with developers on [b]Thursday 14th at 5 pm CEST[/b]:

[h3]Hello, fellow players![/h3]
This update should start the new things we plan for the [b]0.6 update[/b]!
Also, if you were hesitating, the [b]Summer Sale[/b] is starting today, and you can support us by getting the Polylithic now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839060/Polylithic/


[h2] What's new?[/h2]

[*] You can now customize your character when starting a game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/edd6d21ee11b897d0bc1e6ef4ce906528de15de9.png[/img]

All of these are first versions and will improve, but please let us know if we are moving in the right direction.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/c10cd0156543bcd6f68c48502aa8692798503cd8.png[/img]



[h2] New start [/h2]

We have seen that lots of our players are struggling with the start of the game and looking for any guidance. Although we love the element of finding things on your own, we decided to prepare a prolog 
part that we teach you the basics of moving and hunting in entirely new settings with exciting gameplay - starting as a hunter with all the fun stuff at your disposal. With that said, this part will be tied to the main story and will expand it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/269614dd03ff6f1f0624f23ae274a808a523e8d6.png[/img] 

Also, we are rewriting all the starting quests in the current map, adding new and familiar npc and exciting stuff to do (no more gathering 1000 twigs). Heh. So, a complete overhaul of the first part, and we would love to hear your ideas. 


[h2] Farming Era [/h2]

We are also finishing farming mechanics, so you can soon grow and gather your crops. 
The trap system for catching animals is also in development. We believe we have an excellent vision for the game, and hopefully, we can share new graphics and stuff with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/ecea35ac9aa527ad72fa4433c1907860da54571c.png[/img]

[h2] Asking for help [/h2]

As mentioned multiple times, we are just a tiny team working on the game in our spare time for free, using all the money to make a better game. With that said, you can help us, and we would really appreciate it if you could share positive words (if you have some). Even writing a positive review would help tremendously and motivate us, and we need it! 

Best, Pav.

notes.title: Polylithic - 6 Months after Release
notes.notes:
[h3]We celebrate six months after Polylithic 🦣 release with a new update video and a 25% Sale![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839060/Polylithic/

[h3]Polylithic - 6 Months after Release[/h3]

[previewyoutube=vR6OXGRD_rg;full][/previewyoutube]

Half a year has passed since our game was released in Early Access, and as you might have noticed, we have been pretty busy improving and expanding it based on your suggestions and following our timeline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/dd765c9b6eb83974659ccb2c0f51b0dbe61ba9af.png[/img]

Without going into the details, [b]we released over 30 updates since the release. [/b]
Fixing a lot of things while adding new content and features. You can always read the release notes in the game menu or our Discord for more information. [b]The most significant updates were:[/b]

[h3]Sandbox Mode[/h3]
We added a new Sandbox Mode with an automatically generated map and content, so now you can experience prehistoric ages with infinite fun without all those story quests. On top of it, there is a Creative mode where you can try all the new stuff we are adding to a game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/906d0e8dcfd7b9c8124aaef160f630bcf797054e.jpg[/img]

[h3]2nd Era[/h3]
We also started working on the 2nd era. We added a custom modular system for buildings and enclosures for animals with physics and cool interactions, along with some interior pieces like shelves, chairs, tables, decorations, and more. We are still working on taming, breeding, and farming mechanics that should arrive soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/e1efd77039f13c25802d7d7f8d87d8427b1fd589.jpg[/img]

[h3]Quests[/h3]
New fascinating questlines with quirky new characters expanding our multiverse arrived in the campaign. Did I say you can now tame a prehistoric wolf and use it as a companion or help to build the first bicycle?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42930626/b1c0b9b160130657255cd0c5606de25cc90d3b0c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Some other big thighs were:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Multiple language support 
[*] Improve the fight mechanics and weapons
[*] Multiple graphical controls and game settings
[*] Graphical optimization
[*] New character and animal models
[*] New VFX and interactions
[*] UI elements
[*] Robust autosave and save mechanics 
[*] And some easter eggs, for sure!
[/list]
 
[h3]Future[/h3]
As for the near future, we are planning to add a new campaign for the 2nd era with an interesting new set of characters and a detective story that will teach you new farming mechanics. We also started preparing new biomes and seasons for you to explore. Yeah, and mushrooms. We will have to do something about those mushrooms everywhere. But dont worry, we have some ideas for that as well. 

Did you miss something? Please let us know in our Discord or Steam community. 
If you enjoy the game so far, we appreciate your honest review. If not, write to us, and we will do our best to help you or improve your struggles. As you know, we are a tiny group of friends trying to make their first big game, and we would appreciate your help spreading kind words and giving us feedback.

[/list]

To all our tribe members! The update you were waiting for is here and along with it lots of new features. Some of them are still in beta, but you can already get to 2nd era and start testing our building system. 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/603a768ef4a6a57df7ea3ab9/b7d534bc-5014-4034-84ca-dcf4b9bb1127/polylithic_12.png[/img]

[*] [b]Modular buildings can now be constructed[/b]
[*] [b]Additional tutorial quests have been added[/b]
[*] [b]New NPCs with side quests can spawn in the wilderness[/b]
[*] [b]Autosave is added every 10 minutes[/b]
[*] Saving will no longer freeze the game
[*] Save data is verified before overwriting old data
[*] Hoe can be used to spread farmland (for future)
[*] Birds will sometimes fly out of disturbed shrubbery

[*] Mammoths, Bison, and Bears now deal much more damage to trees

[/list]

[b]Please be aware, that everything new is still in testing, and If you encounter any problems, let us know![/b]

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/603a768ef4a6a57df7ea3ab9/f0173d5c-22ca-4c62-b601-85630469e8fe/polylithic-promo-screen29.png[/img]

As you would expect, we are still focusing on laying the foundation for the proper 2nd era where the player is expected to settle down, build up their base, employ more NPCs to their tribe, explore the map, and follow up the story quest. 


[h2]One more thing...[/h2]

We were able to find a legendary Game Designer to help us bring our vision to life! Meet Martin Vano, a game designer with over 13 years of professional experience ranging from AAA games to indie. Martin specializes in narrative design as he loves to create systems and environments that tell stories, He also teaches game design on Czech unis and in GameDevHub. 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/603a768ef4a6a57df7ea3ab9/9833ab70-52b8-47e4-aeec-ab4d15ec79ab/martin-vano2.png[/img]


[h2]More info[/h2]

notes.title: Version 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Hello fellow tribe members. The new year is here along with version 0.4! This might not seem that much of a change but huge things are happening in the backend of the game allowing for the 2nd era of farming.

[list]
[*] Alterations to terrain, down to every blade of grass, are now saved in preparation for the farming era
[*] Trees and boulders now have their health and state saved by the scene
[*] Terrain remains persistent when traveling far away and coming back
[*] Terrain will be reset if loading data from a version of the game with a different generation
[*] Improved performance for a large number of mobs
[*] Reduced VRAM usage by ≈500MB
[*] Adjusted spawn rate of rocks
[*] Wheat now spawns in the world
[*] Additional points of interest have been added throughout the map
[*] Fixed various issues in the terrain
[*] Some inaccessible items added for super secret testing
[*] Small Trees and nut trees can be chopped now
[*] Small visual improvements
[/list]
As always, If you encounter any problems, please let us know!


[h2]Future updates[/h2]

What you can expect in the upcoming updates? The team is now focused on laying the foundation for the farming era that introduces the player to new technologies. Through this, the player will be able to use animals to produce more resources, cultivate the land, and hence start proper production chains.


[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/603a768ef4a6a57df7ea3ab9/066df880-7aab-4351-ad1b-a4e64655e7b5/polylithic_10.png[/img]

The player is expected to settle down, build up their base, employ more NPCs to their tribe, explore the map, and follow up the story quest.


[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/603a768ef4a6a57df7ea3ab9/886720ff-6bc6-4b0e-b676-dc579ab616a0/image+%281%29.png[/img]


The main areas we will be focusing on now are modular building, farming, and taming animals. Later on, we are also planning to introduce a Season System with a Winter / Summer cycle for more fun and challenging gameplay along with the sandbox mode. 


[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/603a768ef4a6a57df7ea3ab9/21d6c9de-5705-4958-8a78-39c4c4166457/quests.PNG?format=2500w[/img]


We will be also adding new special NPCs and their fun questlines to the game world with continuous stories after each migration and some rewards. 

[b]Lastly, we are in the process of looking for help with more advanced game design a system balance.[/b]

notes.title: Polylithic Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
The long-awaited moment has arrived: we're unveiling the official release date for the Early Access version of our game Polylithic on Steam: [b]November 9th, 2023![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839060/Polylithic/

[h2]What to Expect?[/h2]

Completely playable first Era with saving functionality and lots of new tweaks. You can experience the story quests, unlock new technologies, build monument, and command your tribe. We would also like to share our future plans with you so you better understand what’s about to come in the upcoming weeks/months. 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/603a768ef4a6a57df7ea3ab9/78f5607e-5a32-4615-8b49-aac40cefd9c8/polylithic-timeline-plan1.jpg[/img]

After the release, we plan periodic Streams on our Twitch channel [url=https://www.twitch.tv/polyperfect]twitch.tv/polyperfect[/url] sharing the progress of the development with you + a couple of AMAs. Thank you also for all the feedback from the Steam Next Fest Demo!

[h2]When?[/h2]

Early Access to Polylithic starts on the 9th of November with a [b]15% sale[/b]. Don't miss it!

[h2]More?[/h2]
Join our[url=https://discord.gg/polyperfect] Discord[/url] and see the [url=https://twitter.com/polylithicgame]Twitter[/url] page for the news. We look forward to seeing you there.
